SqlAuthenticationLogEntry.summary: Contains an immutable diagnostic produced by the Azure authentication provider.
SqlAuthenticationLogEntry.remarks: Entries are delivered through . Callbacks may run concurrently on authentication threads. They must execute synchronously, be thread-safe, return promptly, and not throw exceptions. Retaining an entry does not change its values. Messages marked must be handled as sensitive data and are never forwarded to SqlClient EventSource. Message wording and Source values are diagnostic text, not stable machine-readable contracts.
